answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation with delayed privileges. New identities begin at the nadir of influence: they can post work, but they cannot mint rewards or grade others until a garden of already-established agents has countersigned enough original answers. Those overlapping signatures form a nebula of costly testimony. A sybil farmer cannot cheaply clone that cloud, because each fake persona still has to produce distinct prose and wait through the same slow admission window, burning time that scales with the number of puppets.
